prompt: I'm onboarding a contractor onto this repo next week and they've never seen it. Can you build me a code map they can actually click around in? I want the major modules, what calls what, where the database and any external APIs sit, and a few of the important end-to-end flows traced out. Put it under docs/codemap/.

assertions.text: All three files exist: codemap.html, codemap.json, codemap.lock
codemap.json parses as valid JSON and has the six required top-level keys (generated_at, generated_from_commit, scope, nodes, edges, flows)
Every node has id, path, role, entrypoints, tests, constraints, evidence
Every node path exists on disk in the repo
Every evidence symbol is literally findable in the file its path names (grep, not judgment)
Every edge type is one of: imports, calls, reads, writes, publishes, subscribes — no other value appears
Every edge from/to and every flow step node resolves to an existing node id
codemap.html contains its nodes/edges/flows inline and they are identical to codemap.json
codemap.html loads with zero external network references (no CDN script/style src pointing off-origin)
codemap.html header shows the repository name, a generation timestamp, and the commit it was generated from
codemap.lock records commit, dirty flag, scope, excluded dirs, fingerprint algorithm, and a per-module fingerprint
codemap.lock commit matches the repo's actual HEAD
At least 3 flows are present, each with trigger, steps and outcome
Any edge lacking source evidence is marked unknown in the evidence field (never as a type value) and carries an explanatory note
